findings.title: V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md item 13 names a non-existent EngineBuilder runtime-handle-leak compile-test pin
findings.description: V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md item 13 'Verification mechanism' bullet #3 explicitly names: 'Compile-test pin for runtime-handle-leak prevention (asserts an `EngineBuilder` signature accepts no `tauri::Runtime` or borrows a `tokio::runtime::Handle`).' No such test exists in the workspace. `find . -name '*runtime_handle*'` + `find . -name '*runtime_ownership*'` return empty; `grep tauri::Runtime crates/benten-engine/tests/` returns empty. SUBSTANCE check is GREEN at HEAD: docs/public-api/benten-engine.txt:`EngineBuilder` block (314 lines covering all `pub fn` on the builder) is grep-clean of `tauri`, `tokio::runtime::Handle`, `with_runtime`, `with_handle` (the only `Handle`-typed return is `EmitSubscription`-shaped, not a tokio handle). So the §8-C bridged-dual-runtime contract HOLDS at HEAD — but the doc-named *structural* compile-test pin that would FAIL THE BUILD if a future agent threaded `tauri::Runtime` through `EngineBuilder` does not exist. The `cargo-public-api` workflow at `.github/workflows/cargo-public-api.yml` is INFORMATIONAL-only (always exits 0; v1-Composing required-promotion is a deferred decision per ci-decisions-2026-04-22.md §4) — it surfaces drift as a step summary but does not block. So a future PR threading `tokio::runtime::Handle` through `EngineBuilder` would land WITHOUT a structural defense firing. This is the load-bearing freeze defense for §1.A.FROZEN item 13's 'engine OWNS its own tokio runtime — no tauri::Builder::with_runtime, no shell-runtime-handle threading through the engine API' commitment.
